title: Users
description: People who can sign in to hop.
roleHelp: Admins manage everything. Members create and edit their own links. Viewers can only look.
disableText: They will be signed out and will not be able to sign in until you enable them again.
resetText: Send this link to the person. It works once and expires in one hour.
revokeText: The link sent to {{email}} will stop working.
inviteText: They get a link to set a password, or to continue with single sign-on.
inviteSent: We sent the invitation by email.
inviteNoMail: Email is not set up, so send this link yourself.
inviteMailFailed: We could not send the email. Send this link yourself.
inviteLinkHint: The link works for 7 days and only once.
